$comment: Hand-maintained case structure. Model definitions are inserted by the GridKit Sphinx schema extension.
title: Phasor Dynamics Case
description: A GridKit phasor-dynamics case containing system metadata, buses, optional signals and monitor sinks, and model-specific devices.

$schema.title: Case schema URL
$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema used to validate this case file.

header.title: Case header
header.description: Format identification, case metadata, and system-wide base quantities.

monitors.title: Monitor sinks
monitors.description: Output destinations for monitored variables. If omitted, GridKit uses its default CSV output to standard output.

buses.title: Buses
buses.description: Electrical buses in the case. Bus numbers are unique nonnegative integer identifiers.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Named signals used to connect device signal inputs and outputs. Signal IDs are unique nonnegative integers.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Model instances connected to buses and signals through class-specific ports.

nonnegative_id.title: Nonnegative identifier
nonnegative_id.description: A bus, signal, or port-reference identifier. Identifiers start at 0.

header.title: Header
header.description: Identifies the case-format version and provides descriptive metadata and system-wide base quantities.

format_version.title: Format version
format_version.description: Integer major version of the GridKit case format.

format_revision.title: Format revision
format_revision.description: Integer revision within the selected GridKit case-format version.

case_date_time.title: Case date and time
case_date_time.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp associated with the case. Include a UTC offset when a time is provided.

case_description.title: Case description
case_description.description: Description of the system and scenario represented by the case.

case_comments.title: Case comments
case_comments.description: Additional notes, provenance, assumptions, or usage guidance for the case.

monitor_sink.title: Monitor output
monitor_sink.description: Configuration for one destination receiving the case's monitored variables.

file_name.title: Output file name
file_name.description: Output file path. If omitted or empty, the monitor is written to standard output.

format.title: Output format
format.description: Serialization format for the monitor output. GridKit matches this value case-insensitively.

delim.title: CSV delimiter
delim.description: Delimiter used for CSV output. This value is ignored for JSON and YAML output.

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: A named connection point used by device signal-input and signal-output ports.

signal_id.title: Signal identifier
signal_id.description: Unique nonnegative integer identifying this signal within the case.

name.title: Signal name
name.description: Human-readable signal name or description. Names need not be unique.

bus_init.title: Bus initialization
bus_init.description: Optional initial rectangular voltage components. Omitted components use their documented defaults.

Vr.title: Initial real voltage
Vr.description: Initial real component of bus voltage in per unit.

Vi.title: Initial imaginary voltage
Vi.description: Initial imaginary component of bus voltage in per unit.

bus.title: Bus model
bus.description: Placeholder replaced during schema generation by the supported bus-model alternatives.

device.title: Device model
device.description: Placeholder replaced during schema generation by the supported device-model alternatives.
